IDAGIO is the leading streaming service for classical music, based in Berlin and part of IDAGIO Group. The Group spans streaming, recordings, and live music partnerships, globally. Our director initiates projects across all of it: recording partnerships with orchestras, licensing talks with international labels, concert-hall collaborations in Taiwan and Japan, and new ventures.
These initiatives move fast and span many time zones. We are looking for the person at the director's side who keeps them all on track.
Tasks
You are the assistant to the sole director of IDAGIO Group and work with him daily. He travels extensively and meets industry leaders, orchestras, and institutions across Asia, Europe and the US. Every trip produces introductions, ideas, and commitments. Your job is to make sure none of them get lost. You track every thread, follow up with every party, and hold everyone to agreed deadlines, including the director.
Beyond that, you coordinate selected projects across the Group's Berlin companies, working with their Managing Directors. Decisions sit with the director and the Managing Directors. Keeping things moving sits with you.
Assistant and project support to the director
Track and follow up on the projects and partnerships the director runs across the Group. You keep an up-to-date overview of status, owners, and next steps at all times.
Maintain deadlines and flag slipping dates early. You chase open items without being asked.
Prepare agendas, briefings, and follow-ups for meetings. Maintain trackers and status summaries.
Coordinate scheduling, information flow, and documentation across internal and external stakeholders, from orchestra managements to distribution partners.
Project coordination for Moto Lab
Moto Lab Partners is the Group's newest venture: it supports classical artists and institutions in building their international presence and careers, from recordings and concert videos to release strategy and promotion.
Coordinate Moto Lab's projects from start to finish, whatever their shape: a release, a concert video production, a marketing campaign, or a partner engagement.
Act as the central point of contact between everyone involved: artists and their management, orchestras, production crews, distributors, agencies, and internal teams.
Track each project's timeline from planning through delivery, follow up on deliverables, and support project and budget administration until everything is complete and approved.

Several years of professional experience, typically 2 to 5, in an assistant, coordination, project management, or artist management role. This should not be your first job. You have managed deadlines across multiple stakeholders and worked alongside a demanding senior principal before.
A firm understanding of classical music and the industry around it: repertoire, orchestras, how recordings and releases work. A background in classical music (studies, an orchestra, a label, an agency, a concert hall) is a strong plus.
Proactive and organized by temperament. You take ownership, chase without being prompted, and flag problems early.
Comfortable running several projects in parallel and prioritizing against deadlines.
Clear, structured communication and documentation. Status is transparent to everyone at any time.
Fluent German and English (C1 or better, spoken and written). Japanese or Mandarin is a real plus given our partners in Japan and Taiwan.
Based in Berlin or willing to relocate. Occasional flexibility for calls with Asia or the US and for concert or recording dates in the evening.

A rare vantage point: you work directly with the director of a music group active between Europe and Asia, and you see every initiative across it.
Real responsibility from day one. The role exists because these projects matter and need an owner.
A small, senior, international team in Berlin with short decision paths.
Salary range: €42,000–50,000 gross/year, depending on experience.
Send a short cover note, your CV, and your earliest possible start date to apply. Tell us about one person or project you supported where your follow-through made the difference.
IDAGIO and the IDAGIO Group value diversity. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements.

Education. Have a doctoral degree in psychology from a graduate program in psychology accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA), the Psychological Clinical Science Accreditation System (PCSAS), or the Canadian Psychological Association (CPA) at the time the program was completed.

The specialty area of the degree must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed. For the purpose of meeting this requirement, the term "specialty area" refers to the specific specialty areas recognized by the accrediting body and not to specific job duties that might require special skills.

Currently, APA accredits doctoral programs in the specialty areas of clinical psychology, counseling psychology, school psychology, or combinations of two or more of those areas. PCSAS accredits doctoral programs in psychological clinical science.

CPA accredits doctoral programs in clinical psychology, counseling psychology, clinical neuropsychology, and school psychology. There are no job assignments in VHA that require the skills of a school psychologist; therefore, an applicant with a degree in the specialty area of school psychology is not eligible for appointment.

Strictly for the purpose of determining eligibility for appointment as a psychologist in VHA, there is no distinction between the specialty areas (with the exception of school psychology).

OR Have a doctoral degree in any area of psychology and, in addition, successfully complete a re- specialization program (including documentation of an approved internship completed as part of the re- specialization program) meeting both of the following conditions: (a) The re-specialization program must be completed in an APA or a CPA accredited doctoral program; and, (b) the specialty in which the applicant is retrained must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR Have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution, with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature. AND Internships.

Have successfully completed a professional psychology internship training program that was accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed and that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR New VHA psychology internship programs that are in the process of applying for APA accreditation are acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement, provided that such programs were sanctioned by the VHA Central Office Program Director for Psychology and the VHA Office of Academic Affiliations at the time that the individual was an intern; OR VHA facilities that offered full-time, one-year pre-doctoral internships prior to PL 96- 151 (pre- 1979) are considered to be acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement; OR Applicants who completed an internship that was not accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed may be considered eligible for hire only if they are currently board certified by the American Board of Professional Psychology in a specialty area that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

(NOTE: Once board certified, the employee is required to maintain board certification.) OR Applicants who have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally- accredited institution with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature may fulfill this internship requirement by having the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience in a site specifically acceptable to the candidate's doctoral program.

If the internship experience is not noted on the applicant's official transcript, the applicant must provide a statement from the doctoral program verifying that the equivalent of a one- year supervised internship experience was completed in a site acceptable to the doctoral program. Licensure.

Hold a full, current, and unrestricted license to practice psychology at the doctoral level in a State, Territory, or Commonwealth of the United States, or the District of Columbia.

May qualify based on being covered by the Grandfathering Provision as described in the VA Qualification Standard for this occupation (only applicable to current VHA employees who are in this occupation and meet the criteria). Grade Determinations: Psychology Program Manager, GS-14 Experience.

At least three years of experience as a professional psychologist, with at least one year equivalent to the GS-13 grade level. Demonstrated Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities.

In addition to the experience above, the candidate must demonstrate all of the following KSAs: Ability to organize work, set priorities, delegate tasks, and meet multiple deadlines. Knowledge of and ability to utilize evidence based practices and clinical practice guidelines appropriately and ability to guide staff in using these tools.

Ability to deal effectively with individuals or groups. Skill in managing and directing the work of others to accomplish program goals and objectives. Ability to translate management goals and objectives into well-coordinated and controlled work operations. Ability to establish and monitor production and performance priorities and standards.

Ability to analyze organizational and operational problems and to develop and implement solutions that result in sound operation of the program. Preferred Experience: Data-driven approach: outcome monitoring, quality improvement initiatives.

Knowledge of current behavioral health trends: trauma-informed care, motivational interviewing, collaborative care models. Excellent multidisciplinary communication and collaboration skills. ## Introduction ##
Pour notre division **Systèmes d'information**, nous recherchons un **Responsable de projets (H/F)** dont la mission principale sera de piloter la mise en oeuvre de projets depuis l'expression du besoin jusqu'au déploiement et au suivi opérationnel.
## *Responsabilités* ##
* Conduire, optimiser et être garant de l'ensemble des ressources du projet/ programme (humains, budget, clientèle, décision finale)
* Diriger la gestion financière du projet ainsi que de toutes les exigences définies (qualité, coût, délai...)
* Assumer l'alignement du projet/ programme aux besoins des métiers
* Organiser, coordonner et animer l'équipe projet/ programme
* Arbitrer les éventuels différends entre l'équipe et les autres intervenants
* Superviser le déroulement du projet
* Coordonner, synthétiser et assurer la qualité des validations prononcées
* Gérer la relation avec les fournisseurs
## *Profil* ##
* Diplôme d'une école d'Ingénieur (Master HES ou EPF)
* Expérience de 3 à 5 ans en gestion de projets, idéalement dans un environnement industriel exigeant
* Expérience dans la conduite de projets s'appuyant sur des pratiques et/ ou méthodes Agiles
* De langue maternelle française avec des bonnes connaissances d'anglais
* Bonne maîtrise des outils et systèmes informatiques
* Maîtrise avérée des approches prédictives et Agiles, ainsi que des outils de gestion de projet
* Rigoureux, autonome, organisé et doté d-un fort sens des responsabilités
* Excellentes capacités d-analyse et de synthèse
* Capacité à adapter l-approche de pilotage au contexte, aux enjeux et au niveau de maturité des équipes
* Esprit d-ouverture et goût du travail en équipe
* Très bonnes aptitudes en communication, leadership naturel et sens du service client
* Grande capacité d-adaptation, essentielle pour appréhender un domaine spécifique à notre activité et piloter des projets variés
## Conclusion ##
Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant, d-excellentes conditions de travail et des prestations sociales de premier ordre.
Nous vous remercions d'adresser un dossier de candidature complet (CV, lettre de motivation, certificats et diplômes).

s.h: 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary
s.t:
As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU.
This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service.
You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform .
You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.
Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:
Customer : What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?
Product : How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?
Engineering : How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?
Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution .
🚀 What you'll own
Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service.
Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform , including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex.
Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding.
Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset.
Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements , making sure each group understands what is needed from the others.
Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required.
Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules.
Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective.
Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early.
Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition.
Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next.
Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery.

s.h: Review and interpret customer technical documentation including
s.t:
Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)
Network and communications diagrams
Site and asset specifications
PPC and controller documentation
Modbus register maps
IP addressing and network information
Functional Design Specifications
Metering and telemetry information

Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together.
Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker.
Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information.
Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process , ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready.
Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including:
Gateway installation and connectivity
Operational acceptance testing
Kraken market and service testing
Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams.
Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones.
Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them.

## Your Purpose ##
The LNG Manager is responsible for inspecting the construction and outfitting of the related LNG equipment and that fitting is done according to international regulation, ship-s contract, technical specifications, and builder standards.

This role is controlling the quality of the materials used, the compliance with regulation and with IGF Code and highlighting any discrepancies within the approved project.

Potential adjustments when minor technical issues are identified by this role, during the construction phase, may be recorded and shared within the Site team and new building division as lesson learnt to be implemented on next projects.

* Ensures that areas under the described discipline are built within the set timescale and in line with the approved technical design, contractual requirements, and functional requisites.
* Follows the installation and outfitting of all LNG equipment and piping maintaining accurate and up to date records of all activities and inspections.
* Attends project meetings and prepares progress reports.
* Ensures that all commissioning activities are held in accordance with the scope and the specifications, are approved by class and relevant authorities such us Flag and USCG representatives.
* Suggests minor adjustments as may be found necessary on site and follows implementation and development of any architectural / technical design change.
* Highlights relevant aspects of the approved design that can be improved for future constructions.
* Involves the Technical Site Specialist(s) during the construction and commissioning phase to ensure that technical accessibility and functionality of equipment is duly verified.
* Highlights relevant aspects of the ship-s design and technical features that might jeopardise the functional requisites and must be improved for the current project or can be improved for future constructions with new building department approval.
* Assists with Plan Approval activities as required.

* Good knowledge of IGF Code.
* Good knowledge of piping, electrical machinery inspection is a plus as she/he may be requested to cooperate with the technical teams for the daily inspections included within the ship-s construction.
* Experience in a leadership position on board LNG vessels or cruise ships with LNG duty might be beneficial.

## Fachbereichsleiter/in Stv. Sozialberatung ##
Das Zentrum für Soziales ist einer der grössten Verbände seiner Art in der Schweiz.

Im Auftrag von 28 Gemeinden mit einem Einzugsgebiet von über 100'000 Personen sind wir mit grossem Engagement, niederschwellig und vernetzt in folgenden Bereichen tätig: Kindes- und Erwachsenenschutzbehörde (KESB), Berufsbeistandschaft, Sozialberatung, Mütter- und Väterberatung, Suchtberatung und Schulsozialarbeit.

Der Fachbereich Sozial- und Suchtberatung ist polyvalent tätig und bietet eine breite Palette an Beratungsangeboten an. Dazu gehören persönliche und wirtschaftliche Sozialhilfe, Jugend- und Erziehungsberatung, Budget- und Schuldenberatung, Abklärungen für Gemeinden und im Bereich des Kindesschutzes für die KESB sowie Suchtberatungen.

Zum Fachbereich gehört auch die Schulsozialarbeit in elf Gemeinden.
### Ihre Aufgaben ###
Gesamtbetriebliche Verantwortung
* Mitverantwortlichkeit für die standortübergreifende Zusammenarbeit und die Integration des Fachbereiches im Zentrum für Soziales
* Mitentscheidung in operativen Belangen
* Aktive Mitarbeit an der Betriebsentwicklung und dem Qualitätsmanagement, sowie Beziehungspflege und fachlicher Austausch mit den Verbandsgemeinden der Region Hochdorf
Personalverantwortung
* Personelle Führung des Teams Sozialberatung am Standort Hochdorf
* Mitwirkung in der Personal- und Teamentwicklung
* Führung der Probezeit-, Mitarbeitenden- und Abschlussgespräche
Fachverantwortung
* Fachliche und operative Verantwortung für das Team Sozialberatung (SB) am Standort Hochdorf
* Fachliches Coaching der Mitarbeitenden
* Fallführung in der polyvalenten Sozialberatung
* Verantwortlichkeit für eine hohe Qualität, fachliche Standards und Effizienz der Sozialberatung sowie der Suchtberatung gemäss Vorgaben Quatheda
* Mitarbeit bei Projekt- und Konzeptarbeit
### Das bringen Sie mit ###
* Abgeschlossenes Studium in Sozialer Arbeit (FH)
* Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einem oder mehreren Berufsfeldern der Sozialen Arbeit
* Führungsweiterbildung (oder die Bereitschaft, diese zu absolvieren)
* Hohe Zuverlässigkeit und Belastbarkeit
* Konfliktfähigkeit und Durchsetzungsfähigkeit
* Kenntnisse im Controlling, Qualitätsmanagement und in der Betriebsentwicklung
* Integrative, reife und loyale Persönlichkeit
### Das bieten wir Ihnen ###
Bezahlte Pausen von 15 min. pro Halbtag 25-33 Tage Ferien, Möglichkeit zu unbezahltem Urlaub/Sabbatical und zusätzlichen Ferienkauf von 1-2 Wochen Wertschätzende Atmosphäre und kollegiales Arbeitsklima Flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell, Möglichkeit zu Homeoffice Frei am Geburtstag (pensenbezogen) Zeitlich sowie finanzielle Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen
